senses.definition: vb. bristle up (LagBN 106 cp. Arabic شَمَرَ contract; in that case ס׳ for שׂ׳);—
Pf. 3 ms. ס׳ מִפַּחְדְּךָ בְשָׂרִי ψ 119:120 from fear of thee did my flesh bristle up, ‘creep.’
Impf. תְּסַמֵּר שַׂעֲרַת בְּשָׂרִי Jb 4:15.
